title: DeepSeek launches Harness, a fully customizable AI agent framework #DeepSeek #AIagents #opensource
description:
DeepSeek launched DeepSeek Harness, a fully customizable, open-source AI agent platform that reached 180,000 stars on GitHub in under a week. Unlike Claude Code, every component of DeepSeek Harness is modular, allowing users to swap models, tools, memory, and the agent loop to build custom AI agents. DeepSeek Harness supports running with any local AI model and integrates Claude Code and Codex sub-agents. It includes 53 free tools out of the box, empowering developers to create tailored AI solutions with maximum flexibility. This innovation highlights a growing trend toward modular, open AI systems that enhance interoperability and user control. The platform’s design promotes a democratization of AI development, enabling researchers and developers to experiment and optimize AI workflows without restrictions from proprietary frameworks. #DeepSeek #DeepSeekHarness #ClaudeCode #AIagents #OpenSourceAI #AItools #ModularAI #CustomAI #ArtificialIntelligence #AIDevelopment #MachineLearning #GithubStars #AIintegration #Codex #AImodularity
